components.purpose: Adaptive ODE integration with automatic stiff/nonstiff method switching
components.selected_profile: double, dense finite-difference Jacobian; C99 diagnostic adapter
components.state_and_reentrancy: Solver state is in caller contexts; read-only coefficient table is shared. Tested interleaved independent solves, not concurrent threads. Dense Jacobian memory grows quadratically in equation count; caller must budget dimension and lifetime.
build_view_adjustments: C99 variadic macros replace GNU comma-swallow syntax; diagnostics keep message but omit source location prefix
Internal printf allocator reserves the NUL byte, checks negative formatting length and allocation failure

components.purpose: Astronomical coordinate systems, calendars/time scales, Earth orientation, star and planetary calculations
components.selected_profile: Full ERFA 2.0.1 C library, SOFA heritage 20231011
components.state_and_reentrancy: Most routines use caller data; mutable global leap-second-table override APIs must be serialized. No ephemeris/Earth-orientation data feed is bundled.
